Corrections and Updates Testimony of the Rate Design Panel (KEDLI) 
Page 1 of 8 
 
Q. 
Please identify the members of the Rate Design Panel. 
1 
A. 
The Rate Design Panel consists of Kellie I. Smith, Dawn M. Herrity, and 
2 
Howard S. Gorman.  This is the same Panel that submitted direct 
3 
testimony as part of KEDLI’s April 30, 2019 filing.  The terms defined in 
4 
the Panel’s direct testimony have the same meaning here. 
5 
 
6 
Q. 
What is the purpose of the Panel’s corrections and updates testimony? 
7 
A. 
The Panel provides corrections and updates to certain items in its direct 
8 
testimony and certain exhibits.  The Panel is updating its ECOSS, revenue 
9 
allocation, rate design, and associated rates (including the MFC) based on 
10 
corrections and updates to the Company’s revenue requirement and other 
11 
changes identified since the April 30, 2019 filing.  The Panel also provides 
12 
revised bill impacts based on the corrected and updated information.  
13 
Further, the Panel is updating revenue forecast items including discounts, 
14 
rent from property, and NYFS revenue.  
15 
 
16 
Q. 
Does the Panel’s testimony also address the Company’s June 11, 2019 
17 
supplemental filing?   
18 
A. 
No.  The supplemental filing was made to illustrate the potential impacts 
19 
to the April 30, 2019 filing if KEDLI is unable to obtain incremental 
20 


--- Page 3 ---
Corrections and Updates Testimony of the Rate Design Panel (KEDLI) 
Page 2 of 8 
natural gas supplies from the NESE project.  At this time, the Company 
1 
remains optimistic that the NESE project will be approved.  Therefore, all 
2 
corrections and/or updates discussed by the Panel pertain to the April 30 
3 
base rate filing.  The Company will continue to update the parties on the 
4 
status of the NESE project and its implications, if any, to this rate filing.   
5 
 
6 
Q. 
Does the Panel sponsor any exhibits to its corrections and updates 
7 
testimony? 
8 
A. 
Yes.  The Panel prepared the following exhibits: 
9 
• Exhibit __ (RDP-2CU) – Revenue forecast at current delivery 
10 
rates, by service class, for the Rate Year and Data Years; 
11 
• Exhibit __ (RDP-3CU) – ECOSS; 
12 
• Exhibit __ (RDP-4CU) – Revenue allocation, rate design, and 
13 
customer bill impacts; 
14 
• Exhibit __ (RDP-6CU) – MFC; 
15 
• Exhibit __ (RDP-7CU) – RDM; 
16 
• Exhibit __ (RDP-8CU) – Tariff Fees; 
17 
• Exhibit __ (RDP-14CU) – Electric Generator Revenue Target;

DPS-338 and DPS-607.

Page 3 of 8 
 
1 
Q. 
Please describe Exhibit __ (RDP-2CU). 
2 
A. 
Exhibit __ (RDP-2CU) provides the Company’s revenue at current rates 
3 
for the Rate Year and Data Years.  The Company is updating revenue at 
4 
current rates, including commodity revenue, to reflect the updated sales 
5 
forecast as explained in the Corrections and Updates Testimony of 
6 
Theodore Poe, Jr., as well as the updates to the forecast of commodity 
7 
costs as explained in the Corrections and Updates Testimony of Elizabeth 
8 
D. Arangio.  The Company is also updating several miscellaneous revenue 
9 
items to reflect updated inflation factors as described in the Corrections 
10 
and Updates Testimony of the Revenue Requirements Panel.     
11 
 
12 
 
The Panel is also correcting several items from the revenue forecast 
13 
submitted in the original filing.  First, the Panel is correcting Gross 
14 
Revenue Tax revenues to address two issues: (i) the MTA rate used in the 
15 
original revenue price-out was not updated to reflect the most current 
16 
MTA rates; and (ii) the Company incorrectly applied delivery GRT rates 
17 
instead of commodity GRT rates to MFC revenue.   
18 
 
19 
 
Second, the Company is also correcting NYFS revenue (shown as Joint 
20 
Facilities in Exhibit __ (RDP-2CU)) as explained in its response to 
21 


--- Page 5 ---
Corrections and Updates Testimony of the Rate Design Panel (KEDLI) 
Page 4 of 8 
Information Request No. DPS-338.  Specifically, the Company identified 
1 
an error in the calculation of forecast NYFS revenue.  In the April 30, 
2 
2019 filing, NYFS revenue was shown as a revenue amount of $1,620,078 
3 
per year.  The correct amount should have been $1,520,078 per year.   
4 
 
5 
 
Further, the Company is revising rent from property revenue to correct an 
6 
error in the calculation of forecast rent from property revenue.  In the 
7 
April 30, 2019 filing, rent from property revenue was shown as revenue 
8 
amounts of $409,189, $429,003, $439,659 and $450,819 for the Rate 
9 
Year, Data Year 1, Data Year 2, and Data Year 3, respectively.  The 
10 
correct amounts should have been $429,891, $440,592, $451,828, and 
11 
$463,625 for the Rate Year, Data Year 1, Data Year 2, and Data Year 3, 
12 
respectively.   
13 
 
14 
 
Lastly, the Company is updating the forecast of economic development 
15 
program discounts (shown as Edgar Discounts on Exhibit __ (RDP-2CU)), 
16 
as described in the Corrections and Updates Testimony of the Future of 
17 
Heat Panel.  In the original filing, Edgar Discounts were shown as a credit 
18 
amount of $219,593 for each of the Rate Year and Data Years.  The 
19 
updated credit amounts are $248,465, $283,034, $312,695, and $377,449 
20 


--- Page 6 ---
Corrections and Updates Testimony of the Rate Design Panel (KEDLI) 
Page 5 of 8 
for the Rate Year, Data Year 1, Data Year 2, and Data Year 3, 
1 
respectively. 
2 
 
3 
Q. 
Please describe Exhibit __ (RDP-3CU). 
4 
A. 
Exhibit __ (RDP-3CU) provides the Company’s ECOSS, which has been 
5 
updated to reflect the updated sales and revenue forecasts and revenue 
6 
requirement.  The Company also made a correction to the calculation of 
7 
the functional Labor allocator, which can be found on Exhibit __ (RDP-
8 
3CU), Schedule 7B, line 79; the effect of this change was negligible.  No 
9 
other changes were made to the ECOSS. 
10 
 
11 
Q. 
Please describe Exhibit __ (RDP-4CU). 
12 
A. 
Exhibit __ (RDP-4CU) provides the Company’s revenue allocation 
13 
schedules.  The Panel is updating these schedules to reflect the updated 
14 
results of the ECOSS, including the sales and revenue forecasts and 
15 
revenue requirements.  To update the revenue allocation, the percentage 
16 
increase in revenue assigned to each service classification in the 
17 
Company’s April 30, 2019 filing was multiplied by 79.8979 percent, with 
18 
one exception.  The change in revenue for SC-9 remains at a proposed 
19 
decrease of 36 percent.  Exhibit __ (RDP-4CU), Schedule 1 shows that the 
20 


--- Page 7 ---
Corrections and Updates Testimony of the Rate Design Panel (KEDLI) 
Page 6 of 8 
revenue targets produce delivery revenue of $807.4 million, consistent 
1 
with the revenue requirement presented at Exhibit ___ (RRP-1CU). 
2 
 
3 
The Company’s corrected and updated rate design produces the 
4 
appropriate revenue target for each class, as shown on Exhibit __ (RDP-
5 
4CU), Schedule 3.  For each service class, the rates were proportionately 
6 
decreased from the rates proposed in the April 30, 2019 filing to produce 
7 
the new revenue target. 
8 
 
9 
The bill impacts resulting from the corrected rates are presented on 
10 
Exhibit __ (RDP-4CU), Schedule 4.  In addition, the Company is 
11 
including bill impacts for SC 17, which were inadvertently omitted from 
12 
the original filing. 
13 
 
14 
Q. 
Please describe Exhibit __ (RDP-6CU). 
15 
A. 
Exhibit __ (RDP-6CU) provides the Company’s calculation of MFC at 
16 
proposed rates.  The schedules included in Exhibit __ (RDP-6CU) have 
17 
been updated to reflect the updates to the Company’s ECOSS and sales 
18 
forecast. 
19 
20

Q. 
Please describe Exhibit __ (RDP-7CU). 
1 
A. 
Exhibit __ (RDP-7CU) provides the Company’s calculation of RDM 
2 
targets.  The schedules included in Exhibit __ (RDP-7CU) have been 
3 
updated to reflect the updates to revenue at proposed rates. 
4 
 
5 
Q. 
Please describe Exhibit __ (RDP-8CU). 
6 
A. 
Exhibit __ (RDP-8CU), Schedule 3 provides the Company’s calculation of 
7 
the Consolidated Billing Charge.  The Company has updated this schedule 
8 
to reflect the updates to revenue at proposed rates and the forecast number 
9 
of bills. 
10 
 
11 
Q. 
Please describe Exhibit __ (RDP-14CU). 
12 
A. 
Exhibit __ (RDP-14CU), provides the Company’s calculation of the 
13 
Electric Generator Revenue target.  As explained in the Company’s 
14 
response to Information Request DPS-607, the Company corrected the 
15 
schedule to reflect the appropriate SC7 and SC14 electric generator 
16 
revenue which did not impact the total electric generator revenue target. 
17 
 
18 
Q. 
Please describe Exhibit __ (RDP-16CU). 
19 
A. 
Exhibit __ (RDP-16CU) provides the workpapers supporting the Panel’s 
20 
exhibits submitted herein.

The SC-1 low income bill impacts are using the Energy Affordability Credit of a $3 for a customer in the Tier 1 benefit level.  
In accordance with the Order in Case 14-M-0565 issued February 17, 2017, there are five Energy Affordability Credit tiers.  
The Heating customers Tiers : Tier 1: $18.00, Tier 2: $37.00, Tier 3: $57.00, Tier 4: $42.00, Tier 5: $18.00 
The Non-Heating customers Tiers : Tier 1-Tier 5: $3.00

SUBJECT:
Electric Generator Revenue 
Request: 
Note: In all interrogatories, all requests for workpapers or supporting calculations shall be 
construed as requesting any Word, Excel or other computer spreadsheet models in 
original electronic format with all formulae intact and unlocked. 
On p. 50 of KEDNY’s Rate Design Panel, and p. 49 of KEDLI’s Rate Design panel, the panels 
state that “[t]he Company is proposing to update the electric generator revenue targets to reflect 
the average revenue received from electric generators in the last two calendar years.”  Provide 
any documentation and workpapers supporting the average revenue received from electric 
generators for the last three calendar years. 
Response: 
Please see Attachment 1.  Attachment 1 is confidential and subject to the Protective Order.  
Please note that the total forecast of electric generator revenue shown on Attachment 1 for 
KEDLI matches the total electric generator revenue target of $38,306,088 included on 
Exhibit__RDP-2 and Exhibit__RDP-14.  However, the split between SC 7 and SC14 revenue on 
these exhibits was incorrect by $12,218.  As shown on Attachment 1, SC7 electric generator 
revenue should have been $1,910,216 instead of $1,897,998 and SC14 electric generator revenue 
should have been $36,395,872 instead of $36,408,090.  The Company will correct the 
presentation of electric generator revenue by class on the above referenced exhibits in Correction 
and Updates.
